result.name: circleShiftedChartCompose_fullJets_fixedBase_oneHigh
result.head:
theorem circleShiftedChartCompose_fullJets_fixedBase_oneHigh
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {gamma : ℝ} {M : CircleModelData}
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hM : IsCircleModel T gamma M)
    (hI : HasInterpolation M.grading) :
    ∃ B ell : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ∀ s : ℕ,
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (travel : ℕ → ℝ)
        (J : SmoothDirections univ (fun x : M.Space × M.Space =>
          circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear hM hT hD hgamma travel x.1 x.2)),
      ∀ x : M.Space × M.Space,
        pairGrading M.grading M.grading B x ≤ R →
      ∀ v : Fin n → M.Space × M.Space,
        M.grading s (J.D n x v) ≤
          C * tameJetSize (pairGrading M.grading M.grading) n s (n + ell) B x v
result.quantifiers: Given actual hD,hT,hgamma>0,hM,hI: choose B and ell once; then forall N,R>=1,s choose C>=0 before every travel, every given genuine full SmoothDirections univ F_travel, every x with pairq_B x<=R, and every N-tuple of directions. The conclusion is q_s(J.D_N x v)<=C*tameJetSize(pairq,N,s,N+ell,B,x,v).
result.source_and_weight: The same CircleModelData and grading are used throughout. In the actual chain gamma=3/4; the material H(sample m)^gamma factor encoded by that grading is preserved. Travel is an external index-dependent real shift, never a vector whose grading is estimated.
result.no_target_hypothesis: Only actual model/interpolation and given genuine tower inputs occur. No bound for the desired full J is an assumption.
result.scope_of159: 159 estimates inverseForwardJet with one source slot. It is applied only after proving the complete actual full-J decomposition with all source slots. The final normalization is of the given CML J.D_N, not of a fabricated full tensor.

literal_supplier_header:
theorem circleShiftedChartCompose_orderedJets_fixedBase_bound :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ (travel : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Set M.Space) (hU : IsOpen U)
          (J : SmoothDirections (U ×ˢ univ) (fun z : M.Space × M.Space =>
            circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear hM hT hD hγ travel z.1 z.2)),
          ∀ e ∈ U, M.grading base e ≤ R → ∀ v : Fin n → M.Space,
            (∀ i, M.grading base (v i) ≤ R) → ∀ y : M.Space,
              M.grading s (inverseForwardJet J n e v y) ≤ C *
                ((1 + M.grading (s + (n + loss)) e +
                    ∑ i, M.grading (s + (n + loss)) (v i)) * M.grading base y +
                  M.grading (s + (n + loss)) y)

identity_proof.product_helper: For any h:Fin(n+1)->Real and i, product over univ.erase i equals product_j h(i.succAbove j). Derive from prod_single_replacement h i 1 and Fin.prod_univ_succAbove applied to j |-> if j=i then 1 else h j. Fin.succAbove_ne removes each conditional. No division or nonzero hypotheses.
identity_proof.actual_full_tensor: For N=n+1, J.D_N x v = inverseForwardJet J0 N x.1 (fun i => (v i).1) x.2 + sum i:Fin N, inverseForwardJet J0 n x.1 (fun j:Fin n => (v(i.succAbove j)).1) (v i).2.
identity_proof.J0: J0 is J with only univ rewritten as univ product univ using Set.univ_prod_univ, so it meets159's domain type. This is a domain type transport, not an existence call or a new representative. Each ordered-to-kernel identity holds for this same genuine J0.
proof_steps: Obtain the already-existing genuine full tower and exact scalar decoder from exists_circleChartComposition_smoothDirections. Use SmoothDirections.unique on univ to identify its derivative CMLs with the given J. Only the given J occurs in the conclusion and numerical normalization.

For each pure source term, use159 circleShiftedChartCompose_orderedJet_eq_kernel, then coupledCircleKernel_decode_apply. Translate the decoded source with circleTranslationContinuousLinear_decode and the public iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const. Addition commutativity identifies the phase with circleCompositionPhase travel x.

Apply M.decode injectivity. Its map_add/map_sum and finite evaluation identities reduce the proposed sum to circleChartCompositionJets_apply. Use the helper for each erased product and Nat.add_sub_cancel for successor order. All N source terms are present; no Schwarz argument or source-symmetry assumption.
For N=0 use J.zero and inverseForwardJet_zero directly. The Fin0 tuple has a unique inhabitant; no deleted-source sum or negative order is needed.

fixed_base_estimate.choose_once: Take B,ell once from159 circleShiftedChartCompose_orderedJets_fixedBase_bound. For fixed N,R>=1,s obtain C_N and, for N>0, C_(N-1) using the same B,ell,R,s.
fixed_base_estimate.definitions: p=pairGrading q q; H=s+(N+ell); A=1+p_H x+sum_i p_H(v_i). For unit directions assume p_B(v_i)<1. Each component low is <=1<=R and each component high is <=the pair high.
fixed_base_estimate.main: 159 gives C_N*((1+q_H x.fst+sum_i q_H(v_i.fst))*q_B x.snd+q_H x.snd). Since q_B x.snd<=R and R>=1, this is <=C_N*R*A. q_H x.snd is absorbed using q_H x.snd<=R*q_H x.snd, so the coefficient remains exactly R, not R+1.
fixed_base_estimate.deleted: For i and N=n+1,159 gives C_n*((1+q_H' x.fst+sum_j q_H'(v(i.succAbove j).fst))*q_B(v_i.snd)+q_H'(v_i.snd)), H'=s+(n+ell). Promote only H'<=H by gradedSeminorm_monotone. Since q_B(v_i.snd)<=1, bound by C_n*(1+q_H x.fst+sum_j q_H(v(i.succAbove j).fst)+q_H(v_i.snd)).
fixed_base_estimate.no_double_count: Fin.sum_univ_succAbove applied to f(j)=p_H(v_j) gives sum_all=f(i)+sum_others. Bound q_H(v_i.snd)<=f(i) and q_H(other.fst)<=f(other); therefore the deleted affine factor is <=A with no extra factor N, R, inverse seminorm or duplicated high slot.
fixed_base_estimate.sum: Seminorm add subadditivity and a finite induction for sum subadditivity give q_s(J.D_N x v)<= (C_N*R+(N:Real)*C_(N-1))*A. For N=0 use C_0*R. The finite sum computation uses explicitly Real coefficients and Fin N binders.
fixed_base_estimate.normalization: Apply current multilinear_bound_of_unitBall to the actual continuous multilinear map J.D_N x, q_s, p_B,p_H, with a=1+p_H x and nonnegative C. Its output is definitionally the requested tameJetSize after explicitly unfolding the project definitions only. The theorem keeps exactly C, so no arity-dependent low base appears.
fixed_base_estimate.final_constant: C_N*R + (N:Real)*C_(N-1) for positive N; C_0*R for N=0. C is chosen before travel, J, x and directions. Parameter loss(N)=N+ell precedes all spatial s and ball radii.
fixed_base_estimate.same_J: No quantitative choice of an alternative J is made. The auxiliary qualitative tower is only an equality witness for the full formula. Unit-ball normalization is explicitly on the supplied J.D_N.
fixed_base_estimate.gamma: The entire proof is internal to q=M.grading and uses the same actual translated source. Hence no H^gamma factor is dropped or recovered from a weaker unweighted estimate.
